ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Dosfuscation Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible payload obfuscation via the commandline

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^\\^.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^\\|\\^.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\,\\;\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;\\;.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\ \\;\\;.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(\\,\\(\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%COMSPEC\\:\\~.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ c\\^m\\^d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^c\\^m\\^d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ c\\^md.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cm\\^d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^cm\\^d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ s\\^et\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ s\\^e\\^t\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ se\\^t\\ .*"))
